title: MFL draft reports
mflLabel: Open MFL draft results (picks happen on MFL)

reports.title: Draft results · pick by pick
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy.

reports.title: Draft results grid · round × franchise
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy. A cell lists every slot drafted by that franchise in that round; traded picks do not shift other cells.

reports.title: Steals and busts · distance from expected
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy. Engine points per game are discounted expected league points per game across the engine’s configured dynasty horizon. Expected is the median current value of drafted players in the same round, not an ADP or draft-day valuation. A bar is the point distance from that baseline (no uncertainty estimate and no letter grade); missing values are not zero. This retrospective comparison is not proof a draft pick was good or bad.

reports.title: Future draft picks · ownership

reports.title: Draft status
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy. Made counts player selections and skipped picks. Remaining counts only unmade picks MFL lists. MFL does not say how many rounds are scheduled or who is on the clock.

reports.title: Average elapsed time per pick
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy. Average and median time since the preceding pick, including overnight pauses. The first pick, missing times and times earlier than the preceding pick do not count. A median under one minute is labelled mostly pre-queued; it can also reflect fast selections. MFL does not report pauses.
